anonymous_observations.limitations: Retained observations are not portable certified-state proofs. Mops file hashes, gateway membership and pricing were not queried again; no balance, audit, ledger, upload, download, deletion or funding operation was called.

facts: Toko uses its configured project canister as certificate source, upload owner and download owner_id. Canic top-up uses IcOps::canister_self() as account.
Toko accepts VITE_CAFFEINE_PROJECT_ID or a zero-like default and defaults bucketName to default-bucket. These source defaults are not provisioning or deployment observations.

Toko parses existing_chunks from the blob-tree response and skips matching chunk hashes. The pinned official client ignores the blob-tree response body; neither source supplies an authoritative lookup or retention/charging contract.
Official certificate result contains method and blob_hash; deletion callback arguments contain only root blobs. No tenant, service operation ID or object incarnation is supplied in those payloads.
Consumer documentation identifies Caffeine as default byte storage. The adapter includes the official Motoko mixin; this is not a second Rust implementation.

CashierAccount performs current-canister balance checks, cycle-funded account_top_up_v1, bootstrap balance setup and explicit delegation management. Cashier principal comes through the official Storage module/environment.
Gateway client uses the canister as owner, default-bucket and the same zero-like project fallback as Toko. It implements GET /v1/blob-tree/ by root, owner and project as a metadata read.

Transient upload reservations can expire; gateway writes retry; refill reports offered cycles on Ok. These consumer choices do not establish server recovery, exact accepted funding or safe retry guarantees.
independent_integration.limitations: Read-only source/documentation review, not a deployment observation or provider endorsement. No account bootstrap, gateway request or paid operation executed. Default project values are not proof of namespace authority.

findings: Explicit Rust/Motoko integration and onboarding through funded payment-account linkage with daily spending limit. General independent Rust integration is documented.
Documents existing_chunks, chunk_check_errors and chunk_already_exists; does not define operation receipts, duplicate charging or recovery retention.

April guide states 30-day storage prepayment and deletion after 30 days at zero balance. These cycle-storage terms differ from app-credit help guidance and are not freshly observed deployment semantics.

Rust deletion list returns vec text; current official Motoko mixin returns vec blob. Rust liveness is unauthenticated, certificate issuance clears pending deletion, confirmation erases roots without a pending check, and Cashier configuration is init-only heap state. Do not copy demo safety/lifecycle behavior.

dfinity_integration_example.execution: Source inspection only; no CLI download/execution, deployment, payment-account change or gateway request.

findings: Canic attaches cycles using bounded_wait. IC properties 9-11 permit lost actual responses and lost attached/refunded cycles on SYS_UNKNOWN.
Unbounded calls conserve attached cycles as accepted plus refunded; bounded calls do too for responses other than SYS_UNKNOWN. Transport acceptance is not proof of Cashier account credit.
Locked ic-cdk Response contains reply bytes rather than a saved refund field. Exact callback-context capture needs PocketIC evidence before production use.
funding_transport_review.proposal: Production direction: durable exact intent, bounded attachments/concurrency, unbounded funding call, call-specific refund capture before further await, separately retained decoded result and uncertainty. No production transport or persistence implemented.
funding_transport_review.local_experiment: Unpublished funding_probe and PocketIC funding tests passed with real cycle acceptance/refunds, independent receiver observations and callback rollback. Receiver traps roll back acceptance and receipts with a full refund. Host-owned ic-memory journals restore synchronously across same-release upgrades, preserving exact attempts, receipts, authority bindings, unresolved-payment blocking and lifetime limits; failed post_upgrade hooks preserve usable journals and blocking before a subsequent successful upgrade. No live Cashier, bounded timeout, old-backup recovery, production persistence or credited-account guarantee.

latest_version_confirmation.decision: Maintainer requires latest integration. Current package vec blob deletion-list shape takes precedence over April example vec text. No legacy fallback; live gateway interoperability remains unqualified.
latest_version_confirmation.limitations: Registry metadata and anonymous Mops/Cashier queries refreshed. No new archive download, gateway server revision or paid provider trial.

official_guidance.finding: General Caffeine app-export guidance calls for replacement file storage. It does not establish external integration is unavailable; concrete Canic/Toko and Rabbithole integration evidence must be considered separately.
Retail upload, storage and bandwidth charges are separate; storage can continue accruing without credits. This is not the Cashier cycles contract or per-object final settlement evidence.
Direct URL serving is public, signed/expiring URLs unsupported, and deletion asynchronous. No operation-specific receipt/retention contract supplied.
